title: Prepared 5-prototype Replicate benchmark — model selection + first-party-bounded per-attempt costs
source: Prices extracted from first-party embedded JSON on each replicate.com model page (per-unit 'prices' blocks). NOT inference, NOT a competitor, NOT a stale estimate.

ledger.enforcement: ODG-side PersistentLedger: reserve worst-case BEFORE each call; cumulative spent+reservations ≤ €250; global ≤8 attempts

prototypes.note: French voices + emotion confirmed present on model

attemptBudget.note: Absolute hard worst case = 8 × most-expensive attempt ($0.75). €5.52 ≪ €250 ceiling (≈45× headroom). The ledger refuses any call that would cross €250 regardless.

gatesStatus.costBounding: VERIFIED (first-party per-unit prices for every attempt; worst-case ≤€5.52 ≪ €250)

billingBlocker.unknown: Whether account naser636 is on ARREARS billing (fully covered by existing controls; no auto-reload concept) or PREPAID with auto-reload (could trigger a CTO-prohibited credit purchase). The public API exposes no billing field; the billing dashboard is credentialed web.
billingBlocker.freePathChecked: Replicate free tier is a trial allowance for accounts WITHOUT billing only; not a guaranteed €0 path when billing state is unknown. Any prediction-create on a billing-enabled account starts a billable run, so no safe €0 probe exists.
billingBlocker.ctoRuleApplied: Do not trigger a paid call whose max cost OR billing risk is unknown. Max cost is now KNOWN; billing RISK (auto-reload/prepaid) remains UNKNOWN → no call issued.
unblockAnyOneOf: (a) CTO confirms account is ARREARS billing → existing controls fully cover it; execute immediately.
(b) CTO confirms PREPAID with auto-reload OFF and accepts drawing existing credit (bounded, no new purchase).
(c) CTO confirms NO billing set up → run free-tier-eligible models at guaranteed €0.
(d) CTO sets a Replicate hard spend limit ≤ a small amount as belt-and-suspenders (optional; ODG ledger already caps).
billingBlocker.onUnblock: Set adapter auth.confirmedBillingArrears=true (or the confirmed-safe equivalent) and run the plan above; the orchestrator downloads each real output, records path + sha256 + measured duration + actual attempt cost + usability decision.
